name: Moganshan Yincuiju
aiSummary: What are the check-in and check-out times at Moganshan Yincuiju?
address: No.61 Xiwuli, Houwu Village, Moganshan Town, Deqing, Zhejiang, China
priceRange: Unbeatable daily deals - quickly find great rates for your ideal stay. And if it's cheaper elsewhere, we'll refund the difference.

comments.quote: 酒店老闆很熱情，服務周到，房間乾淨整潔，面積也大，一次不錯的住宿體驗，早餐也新鮮可口，下次有機會還會再來。
comments.author: Guest User
comments.quoteEn: The owner is welcoming and attentive, and the room was clean, tidy and large. A good stay, and breakfast was fresh and good. I will come back.

comments.quote: 房間服務設施太差，因老闆忙於其他事業打理不善，電視不好用，宣傳圖畫裏的KTV也沒法使用，就住住而已，雖然人還是可以的，但是不用心經營，客户綜合體驗就是差。國慶假期就我們自己去住，網上查詢竟然還顯示有的房間訂出去了。不願意好好乾就別幹了。
comments.author: Guest User
